summaryForNext: All 10 changes landed across 4 risk-ordered rounds: Round 1 (6, one commit 814be24 for 5 + a separate commit e51c376 for fix-waypoint-stage-schema after a cross-repo fix), Round 2 (2, commits 720ba17 wasmtime-disposition + 38f285b run-hot-path-bench), Round 3 (1, commit c90858e rmcp-pin-bump), Round 4 (1, commit 5cdcbde surrealdb-upgrade, the highest-blast-radius change, its own dedicated checkpoint incl. a live-server smoke check). Each change verified via cargo check/test/clippy rather than a formal artifact-refiner QA gate -- that gate was formally retired this phase (not just carried as debt) via the artifact-refiner-gate-decision change. None of the 10 OpenSpec change directories were run through /opsx:verify + /opsx:archive (same disclosed pattern as prior phases). Open items for reflect: the pre-existing type::thing()/type::record() inconsistency found during surrealdb-upgrade (separately tracked as task_7c2fd7ee, not fixed here); the '12 SurrealDB migrations' miscount in this phase's own assessment.md/plan.md (actually Postgres/sqlx migrations); one integration-test resource-contention flake diagnosed and ruled out, not a regression.
